description: Defines the One2MBeanRelationship class for managing one-to-many table-based relationships in SuiteCRM, including methods for adding, removing, loading, and querying relationships.

classes.name: One2MBeanRelationship
classes.description: Represents a table-based one-to-many relationship with methods for managing relationship data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship between two beans, updating links and fields, and saving related beans.

methods.name: updateLinks
methods.description: Updates the link objects for the relationship.

methods.name: updateFields
methods.description: Updates the RHS bean's ID and role fields.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the relationship between two beans, optionally saving the RHS bean.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads related beans based on the link side and query.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query to retrieve related bean IDs.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Builds SQL join statement for the relationship.

methods.name: getSubpanelQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query for subpanel display of related records.

methods.name: relationship_exists
methods.description: Checks if a relationship already exists between two beans.

methods.name: getRelationshipTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the relationship table or RHS table.
